INTC/MU/WDC share counts matched real broker positions exactly, no correction needed there.

All 3 remaining open positions (INTC/MU/WDC, opened 2026-07-27) hit their -1.51% intraday stop as a broad semis selloff continued into a second session (basket down another 5-10% since 7/27's close on top of the prior day's drop). Circuit breaker triggered (3 stops >= 2 threshold) so no new entries were evaluated for buys this run, consistent with $0 buys even though nominal available cash was >0. This plan had been recomputed identically across several consecutive hourly firings since 2026-07-27 without execution (two review_equity_order calls were denied early on, then several tool calls were interrupted before placement) - user explicitly confirmed via direct question to proceed with all 3 stops on this firing, and they were placed and filled cleanly with no broker alerts. Net result: this system is now flat (no open positions), sitting on $1,968.38 of newly pending settlement (INTC $1,858.88 + MU $70.81 + WDC $38.69, settling 2026-07-29) plus the existing SNDK pending settlement. Elevated-scrutiny status remains in force: two consecutive days of stop-outs on every position opened this system's first live day is a meaningful divergence from the honest-fill backtest's typical-regime expectation and warrants the user's attention before any new capital is redeployed.
